title: Effective descent for a specified finite etale overlap system
statement: Let $V$ be a scheme, $A\to V$ a scheme over it, $U\subseteq V$ open, and $P\to U$ finite etale. For a finite family indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}(s)$, let $B_j\to V$ be schemes, $W_j\subseteq V$ opens, $q_j:A\to B_j$ maps over $V$, and $Y_j\to B_j\times_VW_j$ finite etale covers. Fix specified identifications of their pullbacks to $B_j\times_V(W_j\cap U)$ with the pullback of $P$. Assume $\bigcup_jW_j=V$ and fix an overlap system [def-sfb-normal-tower-cover-gluing-data]. This particular overlap system admits a realization in the sense of that definition. No normality, Noetherian, generic-point, or tower hypotheses are assumed: the coherent overlap isomorphisms are inputs, and the resulting global cover must induce exactly those inputs.

proof.text: Put $A_U=A\times_V U$ and use the canonical transports of [def-sfb-normal-tower-cover-gluing-data]. Write $H_j=A\times_VW_j$ and $Z_j$ for the pullback of $Y_j$ along the chart map induced by $q_j$, with its transported identification $\theta_j$ over $A_U$. Let $\pi_i:Z_i\to H_i$ and $O_{ij}=\pi_i^{-1}(H_i\cap H_j)\subseteq Z_i$. Regard $\alpha_{ij}$ as an isomorphism $O_{ij}\to O_{ji}$. Because it lies over $H_i\cap H_j$, it carries $O_{ij}\cap O_{ik}$ exactly to $O_{ji}\cap O_{jk}$; the input overlap system supplies the cocycle there. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-glue-schemes] to get $Z$ with open immersions $\ell_i:Z_i\to Z$ whose images cover, whose intersections are the prescribed $O_{ij}$, and with $\ell_j\alpha_{ij}=\ell_i$ on $O_{ij}$. The maps $Z_i\to H_i\to A$ agree on these overlaps, so [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] gives $\pi:Z\to A$. Its inverse image of $H_j$ is exactly $\ell_j(Z_j)$: a point in that inverse image is $\ell_i(z)$ for some $i$, and its base lies in $H_j$, so $z\in O_{ij}$ and $\ell_i(z)=\ell_j(\alpha_{ij}(z))$; the reverse inclusion follows from $\pi\ell_j=\pi_j$. Thus the open immersion $\ell_j$ identifies $Z_j$ with the open subscheme $\pi^{-1}(H_j)$, giving $Z|_{H_j}\simeq Z_j$ and inducing the specified transition maps.

proof.text: Under the identifications of the gluing construction, each restriction $Z|_{H_j}\to H_j$ is the finite etale map $Z_j\to H_j$ provided as inputs. Since the $H_j$ form an open cover of $A$, [lem-weil-pbc-closed-finite-etale-zariski-local](2),(3) shows that $Z\to A$ is finite etale.

source.place: Finiteness and etaleness are Zariski local on the target; Mathlib IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.iff_of_openCover, with the IsFinite and Etale instances

proof.text: Set $P_A=P\times_UA_U$. The maps $\theta_i:Z|_{H_i\cap A_U}\to P_A|_{H_i\cap A_U}\to P_A$ agree on overlaps: the equality is precisely $\theta_j\alpha_{ij}=\theta_i$ in the input overlap system. By [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] they glue to $\theta:Z\times_{A}A_U\to P_A$. The maps $\theta_i^{-1}$, followed by the chart inclusions into $Z\times_{A}A_U$, agree too, since $\alpha_{ij}=\theta_j^{-1}\theta_i$ and $\ell_j\alpha_{ij}=\ell_i$. Glue them over the open cover of $P_A$ given by the inverse images of $H_i\cap A_U$. The two composites restrict to identities on the respective open covers, so the uniqueness clause of the same gluing node makes them identities globally. Hence $\theta$ is an isomorphism and restricts to every specified $\theta_i$. If the index set is empty, the covering equation forces V and hence A to be empty; empty scheme gluing gives the required empty realization.
